On April 7, 2026, Martin County Water District (Martin District) filed a motion1 
requesting that the Commission schedule an in-person informal conference for the 
purpose of discussing pending matters in this investigation case, and Martin District’s 
ongoing monitoring case, Case No. 2020-00154.2 Martin District’s motion further 
requested that the informal conference satisfy the requirement in the Commission’s 
March 31, 2026 Order for written responses to be filed within 20 days by each board 
member, Martin District, and its manager, and that the need for any additional response 
be held in abeyance pending conduct of the requested informal conference.3 

1 Martin County’s Motion for Informal Conference (Motion) (filed Apr. 7, 2026). 
2 Case No. 2020-00154, Electronic Martin County Water District Management and Operation 
Monitoring Pursuant to KRS 278.250. 
3 Motion at 2. 

Case No. 2026-00065 

-2- 
Case No. 2020-00154 
Martin District’s motion further stated that Greg Crum was not a board member at 
the time of the truck lease discussions that were subject of the underlying case, Case No. 
2025-00249,4 and is not currently a board member.5 

Having reviewed the motion and being otherwise sufficiently advised, the 
Commission finds that Martin District’s request to schedule an informal conference should 
be granted. An in-person informal conference is scheduled on April 20, 2026, at 2 p.m. 
Eastern Daylight Time at the Commission’s offices at 211 Sower Boulevard, Frankfort, 
Kentucky. The Commission does not believe all parties to this case or Case No. 2020-
00154 were listed as in-person attendees; if any party or intervenor desires a link for 
virtual appearance, they should contact Commission Staff. No agenda will be provided 
for this informal conference, as it is being scheduled upon motion by Martin District. 
The Commission further finds that Martin District’s request for the informal 
conference to meet the requirement for written responses by each Board member, Martin 
District and its Manager, is denied. An informal conference with Commission Staff, 
pursuant to 807 KAR 5:001, Section 9, is an opportunity to discuss issues for clarification 
or to assist in disposition of the case; however, an informal conference is not necessarily 
a vehicle to introduce evidence into the record and is often followed with a request for 
information to ensure that the information discussed is properly before the Commission. 
The investigation, in particular, requires a finding of a willful violation of a statute and, in 
order to ensure due process, each individual party and the district must be given an

opportunity to respond to the evidence set forth in the Opening Order.6 However, the 
Commission, on its own motion, will grant an extension of an additional 20 days, until on 
or before May 11, 2026, for the parties to file their responses. The Commission also finds 
that Greg Crum should be dismissed as a party to this proceeding and the case heading 
amended, as he was not a board member at the time of the alleged violations identified 
in the underlying proceeding and is not a current board member. 

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED that: 
1. 
Martin District’s request to schedule an informal conference is granted. 
2. 
An in-person informal conference is scheduled on April 20, 2026, at 2 p.m. 
Eastern Daylight Time at the Commission’s offices at 211 Sower Boulevard, Frankfort, 
Kentucky. If any party desires a link for virtual parties, they shall contact Commission 
Staff. 
3. 
Martin District’s request for the informal conference to meet the requirement 
for written responses by each board member, Martin District and its Manager, is denied. 
4. 
The parties are granted an extension of an additional 20 days, until on or 
before May 11, 2026, to file their written responses. 
5. 
Greg Crum is dismissed as a party to this proceeding. 
6. 
The case heading for Case No. 2026-00065 shall now read as follows:
